messages:
emma.docs: Heads-up: we're changing the SDK default retry policy for user-facing request helpers. New default will be idempotent-only retries (safe GET/health) and no automatic retries for non-idempotent calls (e.g., generate/chat). See internal migration note: https://redwood.inference/internal/docs/retry-policy-change :memo:

ryan.sdk: When does this land? Lots of customers rely on the SDK retry for transient rps spikes.

emma.docs: Timeline: announcement now, SDK warning releases start 2026-05-02, default switch in major SDK releases on 2026-06-01. We'll provide a config toggle to restore old behaviour per-client: `allow_non_idempotent_retries=true` for one release window.

maya.eng: For Dedicated/Private runtimes we should also respect runtime-level opts. I'll add a runtime flag `RUNTIME_ALLOW_LEGACY_RETRIES` that admins can set.

oliver.support: Need customer message copy. Also want a dashboard metric to show failures that were previously masked by retries.

emma.docs: Draft customer blurb: "We're tightening retry behaviour to avoid accidental duplicate model runs — this reduces cost and avoids non-deterministic side-effects. If you depend on automatic retries for important writes, enable the compatibility toggle or contact Support."

ryan.sdk: Will SDKs still surface retry diagnostics? We should log a single warn when a non-idempotent call would have retried previously.

emma.docs: Yes: warn -> error transition. SDKs will emit a deprecation warning for one minor release when non-idempotent retries are detected, with a link to the guide. We'll include a tiny snippet in the docs for configuring the toggle:

```
# python example
client = RedwoodClient(retry_policy='idempotent_only')
# to opt back in (temporary)
client = RedwoodClient(retry_policy='allow_non_idempotent_retries')
```

deploy-bot: internal doc published: /internal/docs/retry-policy-change  scheduled public KB 2026-05-03 :rocket:

maya.eng: I'll add infra telemetry to track how many non-idempotent calls would have retried historically and post a short report by EOD tomorrow.

emma.docs: Great. Support/Growth please review customer copy and KB checklist. Thanks everyone.
